They claim Allah has taken a son, but exalted is He; all in the heavens and earth obey Him, the Originator who says Be, and it is.
Your god is one God; there is no deity except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
Allah, the angels and those of knowledge bear witness that there is no deity except Him, maintaining creation in justice.
The Prophet takes no protector but Allah, fears the punishment of a tremendous Day, knows only Allah removes harm, and declares Him one God, with the Quran revealed to warn.
They make the jinn partners with Allah and invent sons and daughters for Him, but He has no companion or son; there is no deity except Him, the Creator.
Allah provides, controls hearing and sight, brings the living from the dead and arranges every matter; none of their 'partners' begins creation or guides to truth, and most follow assumption.
They say Allah has taken a son, but He is exalted and free of need; those who invent lies about Allah will not succeed and will taste severe punishment.
The Prophet worships only Allah, never what they worship, and must not invoke what cannot benefit or harm, for only Allah removes adversity and none can repel His bounty.
Those called on besides Allah do not answer; all in the heavens and earth prostrate to Him; their allies own no benefit or harm; Allah is Creator of all things.
Allah's command is coming; He is above what they associate, and sends angels with inspiration to whom He wills, to warn that there is no deity but Him.
Allah forbids taking two deities, for He is one God; all in the heavens and earth is His, and worship is due to Him constantly.
Had there been other gods, they would have sought a way to the Owner of the Throne; Allah is far above that, and all things glorify Him.
The Book warns those who say Allah has taken a son, a lie spoken without knowledge by them or their fathers.
The Prophet is only a man to whom it is revealed your god is one God, so whoever hopes to meet his Lord should do good and associate no one.
Saying the Most Merciful has taken a son is so atrocious the heavens almost burst; it does not befit Him, as all in the heavens and earth are His servants.
The Most Merciful, above the Throne, owns everything to beneath the soil and knows what is most hidden; there is no deity but Allah, whose are the best names.
Had there been other gods, the heavens and earth would be ruined; every messenger was told there is no deity but Allah, and those called His son are honored servants.
Allah has taken no son and no deity is with Him, or each would take what it created and seek to overcome others; He knows the unseen and the witnessed.
Exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth, Lord of the Noble Throne, with no deity but Him; whoever invokes another deity without proof answers to Him.
Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion to His Servant; He owns the heavens and earth, has no son or partner, and created all, while their gods create nothing.
Praise is Allah's, who created the heavens and earth, sends rain, steadies the earth, answers the desperate and guides through darkness, and there is no deity with Him.
The Lord creates and chooses as He wills and knows what breasts conceal; He is Allah, with no deity but Him, owner of praise and decision, to whom all return.
Invoke no other deity with Allah, for there is no deity but Him; everything will be destroyed except His Face, and His is the judgement and the return.
Allah creates, provides, causes death and gives life, and none of the claimed partners does any of that; He is exalted above what they associate.
The claimed deities own not an atom's weight in heavens or earth, intercession helps only whom Allah permits, He provides and will judge between people, and He alone is Allah.
People are told to remember Allah's favor, for no creator but Him provides from the heaven and earth, and there is no deity except Him.
By those lined up in rows, those who drive and those who recite, your God is One, Lord of the heavens, the earth, all between them and the sunrises.
Claims that Allah has daughters, that angels are female, that He has begotten, or has lineage with the jinn are lies, and Allah is exalted above what they describe.
Pure religion is Allah's; those worshipping protectors to draw nearer will be judged, and had He wanted a son He could have chosen one, but He is the One.
There is no deity but the Ever-Living, so call on Him sincerely; the Prophet is forbidden to worship others and commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.
The earlier messengers can be asked whether Allah ever made deities to be worshipped besides the Most Merciful.
The Lord of the heavens and earth is above having a son; He alone is deity in heaven and earth, knows the Hour, and those invoked besides Him cannot intercede.
He is Lord of the heavens and earth; there is no deity but Him, who gives life and death, Lord of you and of your first forefathers.
The Prophet is told to know that there is no deity but Allah and to ask forgiveness for his sin and for believing men and women.
People are told to flee to Allah and not set up another deity with Him, by a clear warner from Him.
They are asked whether they created themselves or the heavens, hold their Lord's depositories, know the unseen or have a deity besides Allah, who is exalted above what they associate.
He is Allah, besides whom there is no deity: Knower of the unseen, Most Merciful, Sovereign, Pure, Creator, Fashioner, to whom belong the best names and whom all things exalt.
The masjids are for Allah, so none may be invoked with Him; when Allah's Servant stood supplicating, they almost crowded around him.
Allah is One, the Eternal Refuge; He neither begets nor is born, and nothing is equal to Him.
